**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem (e.g. "Currently, active set QP only supports positive definite quadratic forms...").

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear description of the algorithm or enhancement you want implemented.

**Mathematical Formulation & References**
Please provide relevant equations, papers, or textbooks (e.g. Nocedal & Wright, Boyd & Vandenberghe).

**Additional Context**
Any other context, benchmark instances, or screenshots.
